accepted.summary: use spray pressure of 40 to 60 psi
accepted.quote: Use a spray pressure of 40 to 60 psi.

accepted.summary: do not treat before anticipated major storm which could prevent harvest
accepted.quote: Do not treat before anticipated major storm which could prevent harvest and result in crop loss.

accepted.summary: do not use with additives other than recommended on this label
accepted.quote: Do not use PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco with additives other than recommended on this label.

accepted.applies_to: repeated uses of any ethephon products
accepted.summary: annual active-ingredient cap (tobacco section)
accepted.quote: Do not exceed a maximum of 2 lbs ethephon active ingredient per acre per year through repeated uses of any ethephon products.

accepted.summary: Test spray several plants in more than one location in each field and observe the response to determine proper treatment timing and number of leaves per stalk ready for harvest
accepted.quote: To easily determine the proper treatment timing and the number of leaves per stalk ready for harvest, test spray several plants in more than one location in each field and observe the response.

accepted.summary: Mature leaves will begin to yellow in 24 to 72 hours
accepted.quote: Mature leaves will begin to yellow in 24 to 72 hours.

accepted.summary: Limit use of higher rates to cool (below 65°F at the time of treatment) slow ripening conditions
accepted.quote: Limit use of higher rates to cool (below 65°F at the time of treatment) slow ripening conditions.

accepted.summary: Prepare test spray by mixing one teaspoon of PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco in 1 quart of water
accepted.quote: Prepare your test spray by mixing one teaspoon of PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco in 1 quart of water.

accepted.summary: Spray each test plant with about 1 oz. of this mixture, covering all leaves with a fine mist
accepted.quote: Spray each test plant with about 1 oz. of this mixture, covering all leaves with a fine mist.

accepted.summary: PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco will not color immature sprayed leaves
accepted.quote: PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco wi ll not color immature sprayed leaves.

accepted.summary: All mature, sprayed leaves will begin to color within 24 to 72 hours after application
accepted.quote: All mature, sprayed leaves will begin to color within 24 to 72 hours after PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco applic ation.

accepted.summary: Harvest treated tobacco when leaves have reached the desired color intensity
accepted.quote: Harvest treated tobacco when leaves have reached the desired color intensity.

accepted.summary: Treated and untreated leaves should not be cured together in the same barn
accepted.quote: Since PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco treated leaves cure faster, treated and untreated leaves should not be cured together in the same barn.

rejected.summary: accelerate opening of mature unopened cotton bolls
rejected.quote: A foliar spray of PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco for Cotton and Tobacco will accelerate opening of mature unopened cotton bolls and enhance defoliation which can result in earlier harvest with an increased recoverable yield.

rejected.quote: Use of a nurse tank is highly recommedned for avoiding possible spills of concentrated formulation on spray equipment or any airplane parts.
